name: flow-launcher
description: One-click launcher for aria-flow backend/desktop combinations

scripts.package: electron-packager . 'Flow Launcher' --platform=darwin --icon=build/icon.icns --overwrite --out=dist --ignore='^/dist' && rm -rf ~/Applications/'Flow Launcher.app' && mkdir -p ~/Applications && cp -R 'dist/Flow Launcher-darwin-'*/'Flow Launcher.app' ~/Applications/
